summary: The analyzed candidates show a high prevalence of dual roles. Pemetrexed (212) and morphine (217) are strong confounders and effect modifiers. MET amplification (214) and metabolic response (215) are primarily effect modifiers. Radiographic features like metastasis location (216) and FLAIR hyperintensity (218) exhibit mixed roles as both confounders and modifiers, driven largely by forest-based modeling evidence.
